purpose: Long-lived Astra memory for MediaHub Developer chat sessions and projects.
rules: Chat is an interface to memory, not the memory itself.
Raw messages remain durable; summaries and facts are derived layers.
Memory is advisory and never overrides policy, authorization, evidence, or GitHub source of truth.
Context retrieval is bounded by explicit record and character budgets.
Every durable item should retain provenance to session, project, task, message, or commit when available.
Secrets and credentials must never be stored in memory.

items.title: Gateway integration with durable memory and task outcome recording
Bounded Context Manager for session/project/task context
Session memory: durable chat sessions, decisions, unfinished work and message provenance
Project memory: project identity, repository, revision, architecture, requirements and active state
Conversation compaction and hierarchical summaries without deleting raw history
Semantic retrieval/index with deterministic fallback and bounded context budgets
Memory provenance, conflict/supersession and lifecycle controls
Security/privacy redaction and secret-storage rejection gates
MediaHub Developer chat/project context API contract
24h memory soak: restart, session continuation, project recall and recovery
Independent GOLD verification of memory continuity and bounded context behavior

execution_policy: Autonomous qualification may advance only one write surface at a time, must use fresh tests/evidence, must not create duplicate workers or Actions runs, and must preserve BLOCKED/UNVERIFIED when live evidence is unavailable. Implementation status does not imply GOLD qualification; runtime/soak evidence must independently promote items to VERIFIED.
